animations.name: hover-transition
animations.description: Global hover transition for navigation links and CTA elements with custom easing.

animations.name: puzzle-hover-transition
animations.description: Slower transition for puzzle piece artwork reveal on hover interaction.

animations.name: one-layer-deeper-banner-alternate
animations.css: @keyframes one-layer-deeper-banner-alternate { 0%, 35% { opacity: 0; animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } 50%, 85% { opacity: 1; animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } 100% { opacity: 0; } }
animations.description: Crossfade animation for alternating blog article banner images on a 6-second loop.

animations.name: one-layer-deeper-banner-primary
animations.css: @keyframes one-layer-deeper-banner-primary { 0%, 35% { opacity: 1; animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } 50%, 85% { opacity: 0; animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } 100% { opacity: 1; } }
animations.description: Complementary crossfade animation for primary blog article banner images.

animations.name: article-theme-transition
animations.css: transition: opacity 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), background-color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)
animations.description: Multi-property transition for light/dark theme toggle on blog article pages.

animations.name: theme-toggle-thumb
animations.description: Smooth sliding animation for the theme toggle switch thumb element.

animations.name: piece-underline-fade
animations.description: Fade transition for puzzle piece underline text on hover/focus states.

insights: The design system uses a strict color-coding strategy where Signal Red (#FF2D09) themes Research, Electric Blue (#699EFF) themes Team, and Ink Black (#111111) themes Approach/Vision sections.
Navigation and CTA interactions share a consistent cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) easing curve at 320ms, creating a smooth, slightly bouncy feel across all hover states.
The architectural panel borders with notched connector corners create visual continuity between the puzzle grid and content sections, reinforcing the modular design language.
